brief.title: Transparent sample formula
lines: Start at 50; take one outcome each for role, location and compensation. Keep the total between 0 and 100.
Role matching compares words, without AI or inferred qualifications. Location alternatives use OR: any listed match is enough.
Pay compares a requested minimum to the posted range. Bare values of 1,000 or more and k notation are annual USD in this demo. Hourly rates require /hour; no annual/hourly conversion.
Application ratings show the same total divided by 20 on a five-point scale. Historical statuses, counts, notes and AI-sort confidence are unchanged.

brief.title: Human review
lines: Scores are illustrative examples, not recommendations about actual jobs.
The candidate reviews the posting before deciding to apply.
Profile edits recalculate illustrative scores in this tab. Posting records stay unchanged; no live scan or send runs.
